name: abandon_note2
description: Abandon便签（Abandon Note）是一款适用于 Windows 10 / 11 的本地桌面便签应用。
author: feimingzou

scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test:db && npm run test:wallpaper-storage && npm run test:attachment-storage
scripts.test:window-frame:win: npm run build:native:win && npm run build && electron tests/window-frame-electron.mjs && electron tests/dock-trigger-electron.mjs && electron tests/blur-z-order-electron.mjs && electron tests/note-duration-electron.mjs && electron tests/month-view-electron.mjs && electron tests/week-view-electron.mjs
scripts.build:unpack:win: npm run build:native:win && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.win.yml --win --x64 --dir
scripts.build:win: npm run build:native:win && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.win.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mac.yml --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mac.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
